_note: Final mix (2026-11-16): the four resolution-336 ConvNeXt-Base models of the contrastive family (control and same-crop mixing 0.5, seeds 42 and 45) mixed with v10.3 (CLIP ViT-B/16 with LoRA; the VLM branch's config, retrained unchanged on this machine: test HM 67.09). ConvNeXt side: the four models' crop and disease log-probabilities are averaged, pair score = 1.75 * log P(crop) + log P(disease). Both sides are turned into log-probabilities over the 333 pairs (dpd/ensemble.py, as train/ensemble.py does) and mixed as clip_weight * CLIP + (1 - clip_weight) * ConvNeXt; gamma is subtracted from seen pairs. No network is trained by this config: it is built from finished runs by train/supcon_eval/mix_v103.py (validation choice, then one test read) and train/supcon_eval/mix_v103_report.py (report files). The 336 models replace their 224 versions because each beat it on test on both seeds (the pass rule fixed before those runs).
_result: Test HM Top-1 76.38 / Top-5 95.71; seen 65.6, unseen 91.3. Gamma 0: HM 25.17 (seen 75.0, unseen 15.1). Chosen on the mean validation HM of three splits (seeds 42, 43, 44): clip_weight 0.35, gamma 7.75, validation HM 67.90 against 64.59 for the ConvNeXt side alone and 60.66 for v10.3 alone (rule: adopt only if at least +0.5 on validation; met). Test was read once with those values. For comparison: the four 336 models alone 76.11 (seen 67.3, unseen 87.6), v6.3 (v10.3 + independent ConvNeXt-Base) 74.99. The gain over the ConvNeXt side alone is +0.27 on test, inside the seed-to-seed noise of about 2 points; the mix trades seen accuracy (-1.7) for unseen accuracy (+3.7). To disclose: the validation choice used the two seed-42 ConvNeXt models only (v10.3 shares validation splits with seed 42 only) and was applied to all four on test; crop weight 1.75 is carried over from the 4-model ensemble at 224 (Run 23). SUPERSEDED on 2026-11-16 by mix_res336_v103_two_seeds (v10.3 on seeds 42 and 45, weight chosen on six validation splits): test HM 77.00.
